name: @nuxeo/satori-cli
$tagsComment: A Node tool, and nothing may import it: no depConstraint in eslint.config.mjs lists `type:tool`. Its sources are .mjs, which the module-boundary rule does not read; what they import is the package pipeline in scripts/package-pipeline/, the helpers beside it in scripts/, and libs/shared/app-definition, the app definition's contract, which a tool may use. build.mjs bundles all of it with esbuild into dist/tools/satori-cli/, which runs with Node alone and has no dependency: the build refuses one from node_modules. For `satori mcp` it calls tools/builder-mcp/bundle.mjs, which bundles that project's server and the app generators of tools/satori-generators, by their paths, into mcp.mjs and mcp-generator.mjs: they alone may carry what is installed, the MCP SDK, zod, Prettier and EJS, and bundle.mjs refuses anything else.

build.$inputsComment: Everything the bundle is made from, which nothing in the project graph links to this project: the pipeline's modules and helpers, the app definition's library and its schemas, the config-package generator's builder, scaffolder and templates, the platform's English catalogue, the sources the upgrade check reads of the platform for platform/platform.json, and the server's validator.js, which the build holds to the library. And for agents sync and mcp: the customer edition of the app builder skill, the Builder MCP server's sources and bundle.mjs, the identity guard it imports, the app generators it bundles, and the Prettier configuration it resolves into formatting.json.

test.$comment: selftest.mjs builds the tool into a scratch folder of its own, packs it with npm, and runs it outside this repository under Node's permission model, so it needs no build target first.
test.$inputsComment: The build's inputs, plus what the controls compare the tool with and run it on: scripts/app-package.mjs and the entry points beside it, the validator's bin.mjs, every kit, the npm launcher the pack goes through, and the generator's own copy of the names Satori uses. And this repository's own app builder skill, the control on the customer's; the repository's MCP server, whose tools and generators' answers the bundled ones are held to; and the signature's command.

lint.$comment: Declared rather than inferred: @nx/eslint/plugin infers `eslint:lint`, which `nx affected -t lint` does not match (see tools/satori-generators/project.json).
